(185)༄༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams skor bzhugs so/ // /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (185)༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams skor bzhugs so/// /

(186)༄༅// bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ zhu ba/ khyed dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ sku khams bzang zhing 'gro don rgya che/ gdul bya longs spyod nam mkha' dang mnyam par bzhugs nas yod cing thos pas sems shin tu dga'/ nga rgan ma da lta 'tshams po yod skabs zhu/ khyed dbus gtsang na 'gro don che yang nga la ma phan/ ma bu 'brel pa rmi lam tsam du 'dug go /nga ni rgas mi tshe stong sar zad/ 'chi ba ma dran 'chi khar chos med pa khyed mdo rgyud yon tan thams cad la mkhas kyang*/ nga la lam ston mi med// nga rgan mo nam 'chi dus phan nges shes pa'i gdams pa zab mo gcig zhu mdo phyogs kyi rgyu mtshan dge bshes yon tan rin chen la gsal/ zhu yig mi 'khyal ba'i rten du dngul spo ti gsum bskur yod/ yos lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyer lnga la phul// ༈ /a ma byang chub 'bum gyi yi ge rten dang bcas pa 'phrod/ khyed sku khams bzang po yod 'dug pa legs/ nged kyang dge (187)sbyor la brtson par yod/ na ning dge bshes grags pa bzang po gsum la yig rten dang bcas pa bskur ba byung yod las che/ a ma khams gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin/ de las thar bar 'dod na/ rang dbang gang yod kyi rgyu rnams dge phyogs su gtong zhing chos zab mo ston pa'i bla ma la sgom khrid zhus/ a ma nged kyis gsungs pa'i chos nyams su len pa dka'/ las rgyu 'bras 'di bden par go zhing mig can g.yang sa la mchongs pa rnams rang gi rang slu ba yin te/ de la skyon chen por yod pa the tshom med/ skyes nas 'chi bar thag chod pa shes bzhin du rnam smin gyi dal 'byor mi lus stong log byas nas 'chi chos mi dran pa rnams 'o re brgyal 'gyod de 'chi// tshe 'di'i sgrib shas chung zhing*/ tshe snga ma'i rnam smin gyis ma sgribs na/ nged rang ma bu gnyis bde 'gro thob nges pa'i lam gcig 'tshol thabs yod pas/

'di bzhin thugs la bzhag 'tshal/ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo (188)bo nyid/ thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan lhun gyis 'grub/ khyed ci mdzad dpag med 'gro ba'i mgon// sprang bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// rang mos pa'i bla ma rin po che/ de mdun gyi nam mkhar yang yang bsgom// yid rtse gcig 'dun pas gsol ba thob/ lus tsog pu skyil krung gang bde 'am/ de ma grub gzhog g.yas 'og tu chub/ gnas lte ba nas bzung spyi gtsug bar/ rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba smyug tsam// steng spyi gtsug skar khung thal le ba// sgo ma 'gags thal le yod pa la// sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'gril// tshad sran rdog tsam zhig snying gar bsgom// de sog spugs yungs kar phu btab bzhin/ de the tshom med par rgyangs te thon// de bla ma'i thugs kar thim du chug /dus da nas byang chub ma thob par// ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs/ phaṭa/ ༈ /thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i 'pho chos 'tshams sbyor dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru// gshin po'i don du 'pho ba'i man ngag bstan pa ni// 'o 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du tshe las 'das pa khyod nyon cig /sems can thams cad la skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhi yod pa las/ da lan khyod 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa yin/ de la sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas par byed pa'i thabs 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len pa la// sngon 'gro shes rgyud kyi sdig sgrib rnams bshags pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog (189)gser btso ma lta bu g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can la sangs rgyas dkar po bdun byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gyis bskor ba/ shar du sngon po bdun g.yas sa gnon dang*/

g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor ser po bdun g.yas mchod sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu dmar po bdun mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang du ljang gu bdun g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang mtshan dpes spras pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' bskor du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po chen po gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa ni rten gyi stobs/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po byed pa ni sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid snyam pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar bgyis pas 'dags nges snyam pa ni nyams par sor chud pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa'i lus gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma tsam du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar mos pa'i sgo nas ltung ba bshags pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de nas ltung bshags gsungs/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo khyod 'pho ba'i dngos gzhi nyams su len pa ni/ sa chu la thim pas lus kyi yan lag rnams lci/ chu me la thim pas kha sna skams/ me rlung la thim pas mig gyen la bzlog /rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi (190)dbugs chad/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal thim pa'i dus su dngos grub len pa'i dus yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ngo bo khyed rang gang mos kyi bla ma rnams seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rnam pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog in+d+ra ni la'i mdog ltar sngo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/

dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa mtshan dpes spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos nas gus 'dud rtse gcig tu mdzod/ khyed rang gi lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba lcag 'bring po tsam chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ pad+ma'i snal ma bzhin du srab ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba ste chos bzhi ldan gyi spyi gtsug mthong bug kha yed du yod par mos/ de'i nang du pha las thob pa'i dkar cha zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ma las thob pa'i dmar cha nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma kha bshags pa tsam gyi steng na/ khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu sran rdog 'bring po tsam dkar la 'tsher ba zhig rlung gis spar spar yod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ngag gis phaṭa brjod pa'i tshe khyod rang gi sems kyi ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu de dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du mda' 'phangs ba bzhin du song*/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim pas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur nas bde ba can (191)du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan lhun gyis grub/ khyed ci mdzad dpag med 'gro ba'i mgon// sprang bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// rang mos pa'i bla ma rin po che// de mdun gyi nam mkhar yang yang bsgom/ yid rtse gcig 'dun bas gsol ba thob/ lus tsog pu skyil krung gang bde 'am/ de ma grub gzhog g.yas 'og tu chug /gnas lte ba nas bzung spyi gtsug bar// rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba smyug tsam// steng spyi gtsug dkar khung thal le ba/

sgo ma 'gags thal le yod pa la/ sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'gril/ tshad sran rdog tsam zhig snying gar bsgom// de sog sbubs yungs kar phu btab bzhin// de the tshom med par rgyangs te thon// de bla ma'i thugs kar thim du chug /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar// ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs/ phaṭaḥ /brjod dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag /lan gsum sogs ma thebs bar du bskyar// bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs// yang rang nyid sbyang pa'i tshe dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bsgom/ gsol 'debs kyi 'jug tu phaṭaḥbadun dang nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs brjod// thun re la nyi shu rtsa gcig re tsam bskyar/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma rang gi spyi gtsug nas byon// snying gar bzhugs rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjer bsam// dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun sogs dge rtsa bsngos te// de ltar thun bzhi sogs zhag gsum mam/ bdun gyi bar du bsgom la/ 'byongs pa'i rtags mgo za zhing na ba/ spyi bo tsha ba dang skrangs pa dang*/ chu ser 'bab pa sogs rtags ma thon gyi bar du nyams su len/ (192)rtags thon nas tshe sgrub bam ma nus na tshe gzungs bzla gsungs/ zhes pa 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba brtse ba'i sgo nas gdams shing*/ dmigs pa'i mtshams sbyor khyer bde ba'i phyir tshig lhug 'di rnams// mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po'i gsung rgyun bzhin/ gzhan phan mdzad pa 'ga' zhig gi don du shākya'i btsun pa mkhyen rab byams pas shrī na len+t+ra rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwar sbyar ba'o// sarba dā maṅga lam// 'pho khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// byams mgon gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje// thugs kyi sras po nam mkha' dpal bzang po// smra ba'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen bzod chen pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' legs grub zhabs// skad gnyis smra ba shi'u lo tsā ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog legs rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag=

/sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub zhabs// dam pa'i thugs sras rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /sngon 'gro mi rtag dran pas rgyud sbyangs te// rang sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'tsher// drin can bla ma'i thugs kar rgyangs kyis 'phos// thogs med mkha' spyod bsgrod par byin gyis rlobs// ces rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i 'pho ba'i brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang bsam yas rab byung ba mthu stobs rgya mtsho lags kyis bskur ngor bya bral lhun grub kyis dben gnas rmor dgon par bris pa'o// ༈ /dam pa'i thugs sras kun dga' lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes pa'i rjes su// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs brgya'i khyab (193)bdag che// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhabs// gang des rjes bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= /sngon 'gro sogs/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus sogs sho lo ka 'di nges gsang 'phel rgyas gling pa'i khrod blo bzang smon lam sogs 'ga' zhig nas lha rdzas kyi skyes bcas bskul ba ltar grub pa shing rta lor bris pa'o// sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rigs kun bdag po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// mgon des rjes bzung rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhabs// gang des rjes bzung blo gsal phun tshogs la// gsol ba= /rgyal kun 'dus zhal gsang chen gdams pa'i mdzod// rdo rje 'chang dngos ngag dbang kun mkhyen zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes lce ros su skyes pa 'gyur med mchog grub kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /rong ston 'pho ba sbyang ba'i tshe ngag 'don bya tshul zur bkol mchog gi lam chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// byams mgon gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje// thugs kyi sras po nam mkha' dpal bzang po// smra ba'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen bzod chen pa// gsol ba 'debs so=

/thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' legs grub zhabs// skad gnyis smra ba she'u lo tsā ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog legs rdo rje la// gsol ba= /sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rigs kun bdag po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// mgon des rjes bzung rmor chen (194)rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhabs// gang des rjes bzung blo gsal phun tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so= /skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngag dbang kun mkhyen zhabs// rgyal ba gnyis pa gzims 'og rdo rje 'chang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /sngon 'gro mi rtag dran pas rgyud sbyangs te// rang sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'tsher// drin can bla ma'i thugs kar rgyangs kyis 'phos// thogs med mkha' spyod bsgrod par byin gyis rlobs// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= brgya 'am nyer gcig sogs bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su blangs par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ spro na sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom zhing*// tshig lan cig brjod/ sngon 'gro sdig pa bshags pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can la sangs rgyas dkar po bdun byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gyis bskor ba// shar du sngon po bdun (195)g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/

lhor ser po bdun g.yas mchod sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu dmar po bdun mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang du ljang gu bdun g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang mtshan dpes spras pa na bza' chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa ni rten gyi stobs/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po byed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las nam yang mi bgyid snyam pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar bgyis pas 'dags nges snyam pa ni nyams pa sor chud pa'i stobs te stobs bzhi tshang pa'i sgo nas bshags pa bgyi'o// sems can thams cad dus rtag par bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes sogs ltung bshags nyin re bzhin thun dang po la lan gsum re dang*/ phyi ma rnams la lan gsum re/ ma lcogs na tshar re gsungs/ de nas lus kyi las ni sogs/ thog ma med nas sogs/ sdom pa gsum dang sogs/ mtshams med lnga po sogs/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs rgyun bzhin gsung*/ dngos gzhi la/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de nyid rnam pa rgyal ba (196)rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog in+d+ra nī li'i mdog ltar sngo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa mtshan dpes spras pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ rang gi lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba lcag 'bring po tsam chu shing sdong po ltar drang ba/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ pad+ma'i snal ma bzhin du srab pa// rgya skyegs gi khu ba ltar dmar ba ste chos bzhi ldan gyi spyi gtsug mthong bug kha yeng du yod pa/ de'i nang du pha las thob pa'i dkar cha zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ma las thob pa'i dmar cha nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma kha bshags tsam gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu sran rdog 'bring po tsam dkar la 'tsher ba zhig rlung gis spar spar yod par gyur/ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan lhun 'grub kyi// khyed ci mdzad dpag med 'gro ba'i mgon// sprang bdag la thug rjes gzigs su gsol// rang mos pa'i bla ma rin po che// de mdun gyi nam mkhar yang yang bsgom// yid rtse gcig 'dun pas gsol ba thob// lus tsog pu skyil krung gang bde 'am// de ma grub gzhog g.yas 'og tu chug /gnas lte ba nas bzung spyi gtsug bar// rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba smyug tsam// steng spyi gtsug dkar khung thal le ba// sgo ma 'gags thal le yod pa la// (197)sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'gril// tshad sran rdog tsam zhig snying gar bsgom// de sog spugs yungs kar phu btab bzhin// de the tshom med par rgyangs te thon// de bla ma'i thugs kar thim du chug /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar// ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs// de nas dmigs pa dang bcas/ phaṭa/ brjod pa sogs khrid yig ltar ro// thun 'jog pa na/ bla ma rang gi spyi gtsug nas byon snying gar zhugs/

tshangs bug sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bas bkag par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /ces pa'ang stabs bde khyod kyis rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa'i gsung rab las thur du bsgol ba po ni me tri karma gu ṇa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ/ 'di'i khrid lung gi brgyud pa ni/ gzims 'og rdo rje 'chang byams pa bstan 'dzin phrin las yan ngag 'don gyi brgyud 'debs ltar la/ de nas yongs 'dzin bla ma byams pa phrin las yon tan/ gzims 'og mchog sprul rin po che byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la'o// ༈ /rong ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i 'pho ba'i dmigs khrid skul bzang thar phar 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti// byamaXs mgon gsang gsum rol paX las 'khrungs shing*// ngaXg gi dbaXng phyug rje btsun sa skya pa'i// lta grub 'khrul pa med pa'i bstanaX 'dzinaX mchog /rong ston rnam 'phrul phrin las mtshan can rgyal// gang gi zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud// ngom par thung (198)ba'i legs byas kyi// smra ba'i mgrin pa 'dogs pa la// dbang phyir legs par bshad 'di byas// ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa khyad par can de nyid kyis dmigs rim nyung ngu'i ngag gis bshad par bya ba la gnyis te/ rang nyid kyis sbyang ba dang*/ 'byongs pa na gzhan la 'debs pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi lung dang khrid legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis/ gnas dben par gtsang sbra dang bcas pas mtshams bcad kyis bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste thog mar/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams khrom tshogs su rang la zhal gzigs te bzhugs yod snyam pas/

de dag la snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs bzhin pas/ byams mgon gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje zhes sogs brgyud 'debs tshar gcig 'don// de nas rang gi gnas khang sogs la dmigs pa gtad pas/ de dag thams cad nam mkha' 'ja' yal ba ltar rang yal du song nas stong par gyur pa'i mos pa byed de'i ngang las rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs de nyid yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum gyi khyon lta bu/ 'og gzhi thams cad bai ḍūr+ya'i gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa la/ gser gyi mig mang gi ri mo bris pa mnan na nem la/ btegs na spar ba/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa/ de'i phyi rol du rin po che'i sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i dbus su rang nyid tha mal pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas su tshe 'di'i pha/ g.yon du tshe 'di'i ma/ mdun du dgra bo/ rgyab dang mtha' bskor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad nag khrig ge yod pa'i mos pa byed/ rang gi mdun gyi nam (199)mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal cig phyag gnyis rdo dril thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa longs sku'i cha lugs can/ de'i thugs sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ gsung chos thams cad/ sku dge 'dun 'dus pa'i ngo bo ste kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom/ de yang bdag dang zhes pa'i tshe rang nyid/ 'gro ba nam mkha'i sogs kyi tshe sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas sogs kyi tshe/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la sogs kyi tshe bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kar dmigs pa gtad nas bdag gi rnam 'dren mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs kyi tshe yang thugs kar dmigs pa gtad de bdag gi lam ston pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/

dam pa'i chos sogs kyi tshe bla ma'i mgrin par dmigs pa gtad nas/ bdag gi lam dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sogs kyi tshe sku yongs rdzogs la sems gtad nas lam sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i dmigs pa rnams byed bzhin du skyabs 'gro bzhi skor brgya'am nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod/ de rjes skyabs yul de dag las 'od zer 'phros rang dang sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad byang nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sar bya khyu 'phur ba bzhin gshegs pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len snyam pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum gyis smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ spro na tshig (200)don bzhin dmigs pa bsgom ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyang bya/ de nas thog mar rang gi sngar byas kyi sdig sgrib rnams bshags par bya ste/ de'ang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags dgos pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba shākya thub pa gser mdog phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa la sangs rgyas dkar po bdun byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pas bskor ba/ de dag gi shar te sku mdun du sangs rgyas sngon po bdun g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag /lho ste g.yas su sangs rgyas ser po bdun g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag /nub ste sku rgyab tu sangs rgyas dmar po bdun phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag /byang ste g.yon du ljang gu bdun g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can te ltung bshags kyi sangs rgyas so lngas bskor ba/ de dag thams cad sangs rgyas sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol ba mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtha' bskor du sangs rgyas byang sems mang po sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba/

thams cad rang phyogs la zhal gzigs pa bsgoms te sdig sgrib bshags pa'i yul yin la/ de dag gi drung du rang dang pha mas gtsos pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas rang gzhan gyi sngar byas pa'i sdig pa dang ltung ba rnams re re nas yid la dran par byas nas/ kyi hud bdag gis de lta bu'i sdig pa mi dge bcu la sogs pa dang*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa 'di zhes bya ba dang 'gal ba byas 'dug pas shin tu ma legs snyam pa'i 'gyod pa drag po byed pa ni sun 'byin pa'i stobs te/ bshags bya'i sdig ltung dran par bya ba yin/ da phyin chad sdig pa spyi dang*/ bsrung bya'i sdom pa las 'gal ba'i (201)las srog la babs kyang mi bgyid snyam pa'i gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te sdig ltung spong sems kyi gnyen po bskyed pa yin/ de ltar bgyis pas sngar byas kyi sdig ltung gang yod mi 'dags mi srid pas nges par dag song snyam pa nyams pa sor chud pa'i stobs zhes bya ste/ de ltar stobs bzhi tshang pa'i sgo nas bshags pa byed pa'i mos pa dang ldan pas/ rang lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas ltung bshags tshar gcig gam gsum brjod/ de rjes lus kyi las ni sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes pa'i bar rnam rgyun bzhin gsung*/ dngos gzhi la/ rang gi mdun te smin mtshams nas yar khru phyed bzhi tsam bcal ba'i thad pa rin po che'i khri gru bzhi pa phyogs re la seng ge kha phyir phyogs pa gnyis te brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma dang rgya mnyam pa/ de'i steng na rang gis 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid kyi khrid dang lung rnams thob pa'i bla ma de las bla med kyi dbang chen gang yang rung ba zhig thob pa yin na de ka dang*/ de rigs ma thob na/ rang gi bla med kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs tshad ldan du thob pa'i bla ma gcig gam gnyis gsum sogs dad mos gang che ba rnams dang lhag par gdams pa 'di nyid thob pa'i bla ma rnams dbyer med pa'i ngo bo yin pa la/

rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ston gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu gnyis/ mthe bong nang du bcug pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung nas thugs kar/ g.yon pa 'og dang*/ g.yas pa steng du brtsegs pa bsnol ba sku phyi bltas nang gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can stong gsal sgyu ma lta bu dbu skra (202)nag po ma krugs shing ma 'dzing pa spyi bor thor cog byas pa'i lhag ma sku rgyab la 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i mtshan ma can dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi spras pa'i snyan rgyan dang mgul rgyan/ rin po che'i phreng nub ma'i thad dkar slebs pa'i se mo do'am/ do shal phyed pa/ de 'dra ba lte bar slebs pa'i do shal/ rin po che'i gzhungs lnga'i bar rin po che'i phreng bas sprel ba la dril chung dang g.yer khas spras pa'i rked rgyan nam 'og pags/ rin po che'i dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ sor gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams kyis brgyan pa/ dar ljang gu'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dmar po'i smad g.yogs mnabs pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste mdor na skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ rang gi lus stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin phru ma phus btab pa lta bus lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la/ rtsa dbu ma khong stong sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam zhes pa nang du sran rdog yar 'gro mar 'gro thub pa'i tshod tsam pa/ shin tu drang zhing gsal ba/ shin tu srab pa/ rgya skyegs kyi dwangs ma'i mdog ltar rab tu dmar ba ste chos bzhi po dang ldan pa spyi bor kha yed pa zhes cung zad phye ba'i rnam pa can du gsal btab pa de'i nang du snying ga'i thad la/

khams dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed bshags kyi tshad tsam pa'i steng du/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo 'od hril mo sran ma 'bring po tsam dkar zhing dwangs pa gyen du yar 'phar la khad pa/ spar spar byed pa zhig gsal legs par btab nas/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo (203)bo nyid// ces sogs nas/ ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs/ zhes pa'i bar gdung shugs drag pos 'don cing dmigs pa rnams slar yang gsal 'debs/ de nas/ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rang sems kyi ngo bo 'od kyi gang bu de dkar hril gyis spyi bo nas thon/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kar reg tsam byas/ de ma thag phaṭa zhes brjod pas mar byung tshangs bug nas zhugs/ snying gar dkar hril hril gnas par mos nas de nas sems cung zad gtad/ yang phaṭaḥbarjod pas yar 'phangs bla ma'i thugs kar reg tsam byas/ phaṭa zhes brjod pas mar byung ba sogs sngar ltar bsgoms nas phaṭa lnga ste 'khyon bdun bskyar/ yang rje sangs rgyas sogs tshar gcig brjod/ de rjes yar spar ba dang*/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa gsal po gong ltar byed cing phaṭa bdun bskyang ba sogs thun re la rje sangs rgyas sogs kyi gsol 'debs tshar re la phaṭa bdun bdun sbyar ba de lta bu lan nyer gcig tsam bya/ thun 'jog pa na/ bla ma rang gi spyi bo nas mar byon snying gar bzhugs/ tshangs bug gi kha sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bas bkag nas/ steng nas chu mi 'dzag cing 'og nas rlung mi thar ba sra zhing 'thas par bsgom/ dge ba bsngo zhing thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /de ltar zhag bdun la sogs par thun bzhir nyams su blangs pas// 'byongs pa'i rtags mgon pa mgo na ba dang*/ spyi bo tsha ba dang*/ spyi bo nas zab dang*/ skra rtser zil pa chags pa/ chu ser 'dzag pa sogs 'byung zhing*/ der ku sha'am/ 'jags ma btsugs pas mar la btsugs pa ltar zug 'gro ba yong gi gdug pa myong bas yang yang grub pa yin/

'jag ma song phyed ma zin tsam las 'dzugs mi rung zhing*// btsugs shul du mar phyugs pas rlung 'byung 'jug gi sgo khigs phigs pa yin gsungs/ 'di sbyangs skabs mtshams phyed pa dang*/ mi byed pa'i lugs gnyis snang yang*/ mtshams (204)byas pa rang 'byong sla ba dang*/ rtags sogs kyang nges shes 'drongs par yod kyin 'dug pas mtshams bcad pa rang byed pa gal che ste/ rtags yid ches nges byung nas tshe sgrub gang rung zhig byed pa'am/ ma thub na tshe gzungs gang mang bzla dgos so// gnyis pa gzhan la 'debs pa'i tshe/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ma lus ma/ byang chub snying po sogs rgyun bzhin gsung rjes/ gsung rab ma tshar gsum mam bdun la sogs pa dang*/ byams mgon gnyis pa sogs kyi brgyud 'debs tshar gcig 'don/ de nas 'o tsho las 'das pa sogs rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pas mdzad pa bzhin la/ ltung bshags gsung skabs nye du sogs la phyag 'tshal du bcug pa'i phyag len kyang mthong*/ gang ltar yang*/ skyabs yul dang*/ bshags pa'i yul gyi thub dbang la sangs rgyas so lngas bskor ba dang*/ mdun du bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bsgom pa rnams kyi dus su/ de rnams kyi zhal tshe 'das de la gzigs par bsgom pa dang*/ tshe 'das kyi lus tsog pu lta bur yod par bsgom pa'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar rtsa dbu ma gsal 'debs pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan dmigs pa byed tshul thams cad rang nyid sbyong ba'i skabs dang 'dra bas 'byin 'jug gi dbye ba cung zad kyang ma 'khrul par rang gi rnam dpyod kyis legs par phyes te nyams su len pa dang*/ gzhan la 'pho ba thebs pa'i rtags kyang sngon bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun mkhyen khri 'dur chibs bsgyur skabs/ bud med dbul mo zhig shi ba la rong ston 'pho ba 'debs pa gnang bar ro'i steng du 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug pa dang*/ yang yul der khri chen rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi dngos slob hos ru bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan zhu ba zhig gis tshe 'das gcig la 'pho ba btab par spyi bo nas thod pa lag mthil tsam zhig btsan thabs su brtol te gas mtshams nas chu ser phro ma me yod pa byung (205)'dug pa dang*/

kho bo'i skyabs mchog dam pa gzims 'og thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid sku chung ngu'i dus su na len+t+ra nas grwa ba zhig gshegs pa la 'pho 'debs su thog mar spyan drangs par zhabs phyi a mdo bla ma ngag dbang ye shes zhu pa zhig dang lhan du 'pho ba bka' drin bskyang ba na/ bla ma des ro'i spyi bo'i thad kyi skra gseb tu nas 'bru tshom pa zhig bzhag ste de nas 'pho ba'i dmigs pa rnams sprad nas phaṭaḥkha shas gsungs pa'i tshe nas 'bru rnams gdung gseb la khrab sgra dang bcas 'thor 'gro ba byung 'dug /phyis skyabs rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas de 'dra'i nus pa med mod bla ma de 'pho ba shin tu bzang ba zhig yin zhes gsung gi yod kyang nges pa'i don du rje nyid kyi byin mthu las ma 'das mod/ drang don gyi gsung 'di ltar na/ chos rgyal 'phags pas/ rtogs ldan rgya po'i rdzu 'phrul kyang nga'i yin/ nga'i rdzu 'phrul kyang kho'i yin gsungs pa ltar/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i che bar mngon zhing*/ rtags rab de 'dra yin 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'pho ba 'debs skabs ro'i sna bug g.yas g.yon nas chu ser skya bo dang khrag mdog tsam pa shar gyis yong ba dang*/ kha nang nas swa sgra 'byin pa dang*/ dri mchil gyis 'ong ba sogs kyang 'pho ba thebs pa'i rtags yin zhes rje bla ma'i zhal snga nas thos so// deng sang spyi bo nas skra tshom tsam zhig dpyi thub na 'pho ba thebs pa dang*/ ma thub na ma thebs par yon bdag dang mchod gnas phal cher gyis 'dzin kyin 'dug kyang*/ 'di la nges pa cher ni med pa 'dra ste/ 'pho ba thebs pa'i rtags byung ma byung la ma ltos par/ phal cher shi nas zhag gcig gnyis lon pa dang*/ nam dus dro ba'i skabs su shi nas yun cung zad tsam lon pa'am skra 'then pas byi 'gro ba dang*/ de las ldog pa rnams la dka' ba rang yong ba 'dra zhig snang bas so// yang shi nas yun ring ma lon par 'pho (206)ba byas 'phral skra gzhan gang na 'then kyang mi byi bar spyi bo dang nye ba zhig nas 'then ma thag ling gis byi 'gro ba dang*/

de'i shul nas chu ser 'dzag pa dang*/ dgun dus chu ser rim gyis rdol ba 'khyags ram du gyur nas mthe bong tsam du chags pa sogs yong gi 'dug pa'ang thebs pa'i rtags nges can yin 'dra snyam/ de ltar thebs nges pa'i rtags byung ba sogs 'jog ran pa na bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// ces rong ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i 'pho ba'i dmigs khrid skal ldan thar par 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di yang dpal a mi chos rje'i mchog sprul rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan phrin las bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal snga la 'di nyid kyi lung dang dmigs khrid rgyas par phul skabs phyag mdzod dge slong byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas zab chos 'di'i khrid rgyun mi nub pa'i phyir khrid yig zhig bris zhes gsungs pa dang du blangs te/ shākya'i btsun pa chos smra ba byams pa 'phrin las yon tan gyis na len dra'i chos grwa chen por sug bris su bgyis pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig// /sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// /
